decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 244.15 EUR for the extra posting. Time limit: the disputed transaction TXN-007842 posted on 2026-08-19 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24. That is 66 days, inside the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at QUAYSIDE CLOTHING (MER-000042) on card CRD-000021, each 244.15 EUR and both posted on 2026-08-19. TXN-007841 was made at 2026-08-18 21:20:21Z and TXN-007842 three minutes later at 21:23:21Z. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008056: one approved e-commerce authorisation for 24415 minor units. No refund at this merchant is recorded on the card. Because one authorisation was posted twice for the same amount, it is a duplicate charge under duplicate-same-authorisation. Only the extra posting, TXN-007842, is credited, not both postings. That amount is 24415 minor units, which matches the claim and is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit.
